# Baseline dei fallimenti di `bun test` su questo host Windows/MSYS (misurata il 2026-10-14, prima di toccare gli agenti).
# Un test rosso il cui nome NON e' in questo elenco e' una regressione. Rigenerazione: bun test 2>&1 | grep -E '^\(fail\)' | sed 's/ \[[0-9.]*ms\]$//' | sed 's/^(fail) //' | sort -u
# NB: i nomi delle suite installer/oc2 (install.sh global, install-freellmapi.sh x2, setup-oc2-fm-profile.sh)
# sono flaky da contesa: sotto carico pieno vanno in timeout a 5 s e compaiono qui, in isolamento passano.
# Un elenco piu' corto non e' una regressione; conta solo un nome NUOVO.
comprehension-config — Group D: unknown-tier sweep > no unknown comprehension tier token appears in shipped files
detect-os.sh — natural detection on the active shell > active bash classifies as a supported kind (or reports unsupported)
detect-os.sh — preflight > KIT_FORCE_KIND overrides for each supported kind exit 0 with the right kind
detect-os.sh — preflight > KIT_FORCE_KIND with an unknown kind exits non-zero
detect-os.sh — preflight > KIT_FORCE_UNSUPPORTED=1 exits non-zero with a diagnostic
install.sh — OS gate runs before argument parsing > each supported kind passes the gate and proceeds to arg parsing
install.sh — OS gate runs before argument parsing > KIT_FORCE_UNSUPPORTED=1 makes install.sh exit non-zero with a clear diagnostic
install.sh — OS gate runs before argument parsing > KIT_SKIP_OS_CHECK=1 bypasses the OS gate
install.sh — OS gate runs before argument parsing > no-args invocation on a supported shell prints usage and exits 1
install.sh global — resolves {{TIER_*}} model tokens > installed agents contain no literal tier tokens
install-freellmapi.sh > installa il kit e cabla il profilo freellmapi (offline)
install-freellmapi.sh > la guardia avverte che senza catalogo runtime serve oc2-fm
setup-oc2-fm-profile.sh (oc2-home usa-e-getta) > crea il profilo, la mappa completa e gli shim
telemetry isolation — start-session + docs policy (v0.4.0) > loaded set unchanged: progress, decisions, issues — no comprehension log in step 2
validate-models.sh — agent files contain unresolved {{TIER_*}} literals > exit non-zero when an agent uses an unrecognised {{TIER_*}} token
validate-models.sh — generic preset with unresolved placeholders > exit non-zero when --preset is unknown
validate-models.sh — generic preset with unresolved placeholders > exit non-zero with placeholder diagnostics
validate-models.sh — known-good default preset > exit 0 even when --preset is omitted (uses default_preset)
validate-models.sh — known-good default preset > exit 0 on the known-good default profile
validate-models.sh — missing config file > exit non-zero with a clear diagnostic
validate-models.sh — preset missing a required tier > exit non-zero and names the missing required tier
validate-models.sh — three-tier legacy preset (backward-compat) > exit 0 with fallback notes printed
